camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListCrawlers --region cn-hangzhou --Type starrocks --Owner 1000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ProjectId 100 --DataSourceIds 12345 --EnvType Prod --Name example_crawler
description_en: Queries metadata crawlers by paging with filtering by workspace, data source, type, environment, owner, and name
description_zh: 分页查询元数据采集器，并可按工作空间、数据源、类型、环境、负责人和名称筛选
name: ListCrawlers

parameters.help_en: The list of data source IDs. A maximum of 10 IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源 ID 列表，最多支持 10 个
parameters.name: data_source_ids

parameters.help_en: The crawler type. Call GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities to query the valid values supported in the current region
parameters.help_zh: 采集器类型。可调用 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 查询当前地域支持的取值
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks environment type. Valid values:
Dev: development environment.
Prod: production environment
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks 环境类型。Dev 表示开发环境，Prod 表示生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks user ID of the crawler owner
parameters.help_zh: 采集器负责人的 DataWorks 用户 ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The metadata crawler name. Supports fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 元数据采集器名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条目数，默认值为 20，最大值为 100
parameters.name: page_size
